title: Shifting executory interest — cutting-short axis in a third party
signal: A conveyance 'to A and his heirs, but if [third person] meets a condition, then to [third person] and his heirs' — fee simple subject to an executory limitation with a contingent shifting executory interest in a third party.
student_move: Run the axis check: (1) does the future interest cut short a prior estate? (yes -> executory, not remainder). (2) is the future interest in the grantor or a third party? (third party -> shifting, not springing). Combine: shifting executory interest.
tiny_rule: Cutting-short + third party = shifting executory interest. Cutting-short + grantor = springing executory interest. No cutting-short + life estate = remainder.
trap: The dominant trap is to call it a 'vested remainder subject to open' because there is no life estate to support a remainder. The threshold defect is that the future interest is executory, not a remainder.

title: Recording vs Validity
signal: Valid deed delivered and accepted, but not recorded.
student_move: Ask: original parties or outsider priority?
tiny_rule: No outsider: recording is not required for title to pass between grantor and grantee.
trap: Treating the recorder’s office as the title-transfer event.

title: Role Description as Grantee
student_move: Ask whether one person fit that role at delivery.
tiny_rule: Role description is enough if it identifies one person at delivery.
trap: Do not require the personal name or grantee signature.

title: Foreclosure: bring interest holders into court
signal: Foreclosure request + life estate/remainder + no notice/service
student_move: Cut every sale-scope answer until the service threshold is satisfied.
tiny_rule: No notice to affected estate holders, no sale order.
trap: Choosing the estate that can be sold instead of the process answer.

title: Reliction: gradual water retreat adds land to the adjoining parcel
signal: Water naturally and gradually recedes, exposing dry land.
student_move: Ask which parcel touches the exposed strip.
tiny_rule: Gradual natural reliction generally gives exposed land to the adjoining littoral owner.

title: Life tenant pays interest; remainderman pays principal
student_move: Name the two payment components before choosing.
tiny_rule: Interest is current-use cost; principal is future-equity cost.
trap: Choosing whoever seems more morally responsible for the whole mortgage.

title: Minimal Deed Formalities
signal: Informal writing, present transfer words, no money, no notarization, no recording.
student_move: Ask whether the writing hits the minimum transfer elements before adding extra gates.
tiny_rule: Writing + parties + land + present transfer + grantor authentication + delivery + acceptance is enough between the parties.
trap: Contract or courthouse instincts add requirements the tested rule does not require.

title: Original Clause vs Later Conduct
signal: Lease restricts assignment, but landlord accepts rent from assignee.
student_move: Do not stop at the restriction. Check whether the landlord later acted like the transfer was accepted.
tiny_rule: Known breach + rent accepted without objection can waive forfeiture.
trap: Choosing the original clause after the landlord's later conduct changes the result.

title: Whole taking of leased premises
signal: Entire leased parcel is condemned during an unexpired term.
student_move: Ask for both consequences: rent and award.
tiny_rule: Whole taking = leasehold gone; future rent gone; leasehold value claim remains.
trap: Picking only the rent half or only the award half.
